correctness.rationale: The assigned exact formulas express \(p'-q'\) as a positive-denominator multiple of a quartic \(P_4\) and \(p'+q'\) as a positive-denominator multiple of a sextic \(P_6\), with the displayed overall signs. The inspected verifier reconstructs the rational functions from the source coefficients and proves both factorizations symbolically. Exact Sturm counts give zero roots of \(P_4\) and one root of \(P_6\) in \((-1,1)\); exact rational evaluations at the two decimal endpoints bracket the sextic root. Since \(P_4(0)<0\) and \(P_6(0)<0\), the factor signs yield exactly the stated Jacobian partition. An independent replay of the symbolic factorization and Sturm counts agreed with the package certificate.

final_claim: For the Wang--Zhong Dorff ellipse counterexample, the self-convolution Jacobian on the real diameter has exactly one zero \(x_*\), with \(-0.961916078016036<x_*<-0.961916078016035\); it is negative on \((-1,x_*)\) and positive on \((x_*,1)\).
